mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_pending_action (user_id, tool_call_id, tool_name, arguments, status, create_time, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolName}, #{arguments}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, tool_call_id AS toolCallId, tool_name AS toolName, arguments, status, create_time AS createTime, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM agent_pending_action WHERE id = #{id}
